effect.scp_unleashed.scp548_frostbite.de: A deep, biting cold that will not leave you alone.
SCP-548, "Ice Spiders": hand-sized cobalt spiders that are always far colder than the air around them. Euclid-class.
Standing right beside one is enough to start freezing. Insulated clothing helps.
Their bite carries a deep cold that lingers for a while.
Kept properly cold they are docile. Let them warm up and they turn on anyone nearby and look for a way out.
It never spawns naturally. It arrives sealed in a Transfer Pod.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp548.0: Arrives sealed. Don't open it until the cell is cold.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp548.1: Insulated suits only. Don't linger by the glass.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.title: Ice Spiders
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.caption: SCP-548 instances in their terrarium. Each is roughly the size of a hand.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.0.text.0: SCP-548 is housed in a lidded glass terrarium inside a refrigerated containment cell. **Refrigeration is to run at all times**, and the cell's supply is to be backed by an independent source.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.0.text.1: The terrarium holds bare stone and a few hides. Snow, ice and frozen material of any kind are not to be brought into the cell.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.0.text.2: Handlers are to wear fully insulated suits and must not stand by the terrarium for longer than a task requires. Cold injuries are to be treated at once by warming. %rFurther measures withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.0.text.3: Any fault in the cooling system is to be reported immediately, and personnel are to leave the cell until it is restored.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.0: SCP-548 is a small colony of anomalous spiders resembling tarantulas, each about the size of a hand, with deep cobalt bodies and thick, bristled legs. Small icicles form under their legs.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.1: Instances are always far colder than their surroundings. Anyone who stands close to one for long begins to freeze, and heavy insulation is the only reliable protection.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.2: An instance's bite carries an intensely cold venom. The bitten area chills rapidly, and the cold lingers for some time before it fades.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.3: Kept cold, instances are docile. They wander their enclosure, groom and settle into its corners. As their surroundings warm they grow restless, then aggressive, and attempt to leave any enclosure they are kept in.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.4: Instances survive being frozen solid and resume normal behaviour once thawed. The colony has grown since recovery. %rCause under review.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.2.title: Addendum 548-1: Incident Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.2.text.0: During a scheduled power test, the cell's cooling was shut down for nine minutes. Within a few minutes instances were observed climbing the terrarium walls and pressing against the lid.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.2.text.1: When cooling was restored one instance was found outside the glass. The handler who recovered it reported "a burning cold" through the gloves. Power tests have since been discontinued.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.3.title: Addendum 548-2: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.3.text: SCP-548 was delivered to a reader of this file inside a Transfer Pod. See field notes.
Even a calm one bites back when struck, and the others nearby join in until the attacker backs away.
Away from the cold they frost over whatever holds them in until it cracks apart, and the hotter it is the faster they work. Water around them freezes.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp548.2: Warm cells crack. Snow won't do.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.0.text.4: Cells at sites in warm regions require additional cooling units, placed closer to the terrarium.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.5: Outside cold climates, agitated instances coat the surfaces around them in frost until the material fractures. Glass and stone enclosures have failed this way, and failures come faster in hot regions. Standing water near an instance freezes over.
dossier.scp_unleashed.548.page.1.text.6: Struck instances retaliate even when chilled, and nearby instances join them. They settle again once the aggressor withdraws.
